# Task prompt contract

`task_preset_prompts.json` was initially captured from clean backend HEAD `4b51e861a4e9aeccbaece6f6f50666b30fbeeaf7` and contains complete Planning, Decision, Classification and Talk messages/model IDs using only the existing synthetic tree, PNG, fixed responses and fake voice/audio boundaries. The original `flag_burger` literal was selected before module execution (0 and 1), so its import-time Planning hint and later stage hints agreed. No live provider or personal data was used. Keep these fixtures independent of the new preset writer; intentional prompt changes require a separate review.

On 2026-10-14, the separately reviewed Categories format clarification replaced only its instruction sentence in the two preset fixtures: exact input identifiers are keys, entry values contain only `text`, and SelectedUI context objects still require `name`. Reversing those two replacements reproduces the previous fixture byte for byte; all other messages, examples and model IDs remain unchanged.
